killedBy: the Configuration body loads when its pane first opens (issue #1015) an ordinary page builds no body, even after every import has settled
the Configuration body loads when its pane first opens (issue #1015) a developer page builds no body until Configuration opens
why: Issue #1015. The Configuration menu's modules are loaded at construction again, on every page, as the menu was built before the issue. An ordinary page then downloads `devtools-menu`, `dev-config-menu` and `dev-config`, and the load builds the body into `.hud-devcfg-body` once it lands: construction's own `setState('launch')` finds the pane closed, so it spends no generation. The load is asynchronous, so only a case that lets every import settle before asserting the absence catches it: the two absence cases. The download itself is the browser probe's to see.
